title: The Water Climbed 481 m. The Wave Didn't. #Shorts
description:
In Alaska's Tracy Arm, water ran 481 m up a fjord wall, but the wave itself was only about 100 m tall (simulated).
All visuals are illustrations.
Source: Shugar et al., Science (2026)
#Megatsunami #Alaska #EarthScience
